theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tl_growth_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (ρ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P)), 0 < ρ → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall x ρ) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ z in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * s ^ n)
